title: Rooftop Hot Tub | 3 BR | Luxury 7 Min to Broadway
description:
Boutique modern organic retreat near Nashville’s creative core. This design-forward home features 3 private en-suite bedroom suites, a spa-level primary wet room, and a fully equipped chef-ready kitchen designed for comfort and everyday living. Curated interiors prioritize privacy and calm. Relax on the private rooftop turf deck with hot tub, ideal for quiet evenings. Best suited for design-savvy couples and professionals seeking an elevated, well-maintained stay.

The space
This brand new professionally designed 3 bed, 3.5 bath East Nashville home was built for groups who want more than just a place to stay—it’s a full luxurious experience.

Step into a bright, open-concept living space with soaring ceilings, exposed beams, and a clean organic modern design that feels high-end from the moment you walk in. The main level is built to gather, with a spacious living room, designer kitchen, and dining area surrounded by natural light.

The kitchen is fully equipped and ready for anything—whether it’s a casual breakfast, group dinner, or pregame before heading out. Custom cabinetry, large island seating, and premium finishes make it as functional as it is visually striking.

Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed for comfort and privacy, with ensuite bathrooms throughout. The spa-style wet room brings a boutique hotel feel, giving you a place to reset after a day (or night) in Nashville.

Upstairs is where this home really separates itself—your private rooftop deck with hot tub. Whether you’re starting the day with coffee or ending it under the lights, this is the space guests remember.

Located on E Trinity, you’re minutes to downtown, Broadway, and Nissan Stadium, while still being right in the heart of East Nashville. Walk or take a quick ride to East Nashville Beer Works and some of the city’s best local spots.

This home was designed intentionally—for comfort, for style, and for creating a stay that feels luxurious from start to finish.

Guest access
Full access to the Unit

Other things to note
Please note the hot tubs are cleaned after every stay. The water does take time to get to its normal temperature. Also, please keep in mind, it does take around 30 seconds for the hot water to reach the showers.

Please keep in mind any rules broken will result in a $500 fine
